title: ds-house: .harness/config/ds-house.json
description: Where the project's in-house design system lives, for the ds-house mod. The agent reads this file; every key is optional, and a fact left out is discovered from the code (the workspace package every app imports its primitives from, the token file they read, design-system documents in the harness). `$`-prefixed keys are comments.

uiPackage.description: The shared UI package or directory primitives come from (e.g. "@acme/ui" or "packages/ui"). Default: discovered, the workspace package every app imports its button/card/dialog from.

brandColorSource.description: The one function, token or file brand color is read from (e.g. "packages/ui/src/theme/brand.ts"). Default: discovered from the token file the house primitives read.

tokenPrefix.description: Prefix of the house's CSS custom properties / design tokens (e.g. "--acme-"). Default: discovered from the house token file.

contracts.description: Paths relative to the project root, or URIs the harness can resolve (a `doc://` page read through the project's docs tool), of the documents that define the system: typically the art-direction contract, the token reference and the admission test. Default: discovered in the harness (contracts/, rules/) or the UI package's README.
